testing_guidelines.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based identifiers for all key elements

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark mode is default with crisp dark slates (#080C14 and #0F172A).
Never use raw transparent backgrounds on navigation header or modal dialogs; use backdrop-blur with slate overlay.
Make the fundraising goal input prominent with preset quick buttons ($250K, $500K, $1M) that prefill the input.
Ensure all forms and buttons have proper data-testid attributes for testing.
Reuse existing testimonial carousel component while keeping the visual theme cohesive.
Keep the tone software-led, highly professional, and empowering for nonprofit boards.
